run_demo_forcefield: run a demo of a trained force field model using the latest checkpoint and Hydra config
run_main_entry: run the Hydra-configured main entry point to load experiment config and execute the demo
load_latest_checkpoint: load the latest .pth checkpoint file from the model checkpoints directory
instantiate_model_hydra: instantiate a force field model and demo runner using hydra.utils.instantiate from config
set_test_params: set test parameters including task name, sensor, checkpoint, and output path for the demo
